description: Revoke one of your mail credentials by credential_id; sessions disconnect within five seconds. Repeated revocation is safe. Requires account scope and a stable request_id. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

credential_id.description: ID from your credential creation or list result

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

name: mail_credential_revoke
